tools.name: get_graph_summary
tools.intent: Orientation entry point: graph statistics, entity/relation counts, domain overview — before any specific query.

tools.name: extract_entities
tools.intent: Named entity extraction from arbitrary text — feed in a document, conversation excerpt, or design spec and get structured entities back.

tools.name: extract_relations
tools.intent: Extract triplet relations (subject-predicate-object) from text — builds the graph's edge structure from unstructured content.

tools.name: add_entity
tools.intent: Manually add a knowledge graph node with properties — for facts already known but not present in text to extract.

tools.name: add_relationship
tools.intent: Manually add an edge between two existing entities — link concepts connected through reasoning.

tools.name: record_decision
tools.intent: Persist an architectural decision as a provenance-tracked node with context, rationale, alternatives, and constraints.

tools.name: query_decisions
tools.intent: Search the decision history by keyword, date range, or domain — 'what did we decide about authentication?'

tools.name: find_precedents
tools.intent: Semantic precedent lookup — 'has a decision like this been made before?' Returns similar past decisions ranked by relevance.

tools.name: get_causal_chain
tools.intent: Full causal ancestry of a decision or entity — trace every 'because' back to root assumptions.

tools.name: run_reasoning
tools.intent: Forward-chaining IF/THEN rules over the graph — derive new facts, check consistency, or flag conflicts.

tools.name: export_graph
tools.intent: Export the current graph in RDF, JSON, or Parquet format for archival snapshots or audit trails.
